personality_one_liner: An engaging, trustworthy, and modern rewards experience featuring large rounded cards, soft shadows, and clean, playful accents.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around cards (lg/xl). Consistent vertical rhythm using flex gaps. Thumb-friendly touch targets with ample safe area clearance.

do's: Use subtle glass over brand-tinted backgrounds for floating action buttons or bottom sheet drag handles.
Apply to bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
dont's: Do not use glass on main feed task cards or form inputs.
Avoid heavy blur that affects text readability.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Onboarding screen emphasizing trust, high payouts, and easy login.

states.error: Standard alert or inline red text if login fails.

screens.layout: Centered logo (two gold coins) at top. Bold 'TaskMint' title and subtitle 'Earn rewards. Get paid. Anytime.' directly below. Main content is a pure white card (radius: xl, shadow 2) containing a 3D rounded gift box image at the top, followed by 3 vertical feature rows. Each row has a brandTertiary (soft lavender) circular icon container and a bold label. Below the card, a sticky brandPrimary (near-black navy) pill button for 'Continue'. Small muted footer text underneath the button.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main feed showcasing rewards points, featured banners, and task offers.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for banner and task cards.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty box with 'No tasks available right now' and a 'Refresh' CTA.
states.error: Error message with 'Tap to retry' button.

screens.layout: Top Header: Left profile avatar and 'Hello, User889B'. Right: brandTertiary pill with coin icon and point balance. Below header: Full-width rounded sliding banner carousel with pagination dots. Below banner: Segmented toggle with active pill (brandSecondary/indigo, white text, badge) for 'Offerwall' and inactive pill (white, dark text) for 'Play & Earn'. Below toggle: Vertical list of pure white task cards (radius: lg, shadow 2). Each task card contains a rounded square logo on the left, bold title + grey subtitle center, and bold success (green) amount + chevron on the right.

screens.name: Wallet
screens.purpose: Manage balance, withdrawals, and transaction history.

states.empty: Illustration of empty wallet with 'No transactions yet'.

screens.layout: Top hero card (surfaceSecondary) displaying large current balance. Below: UPI/Bank sub-tabs (segmented style). Withdraw section: Quick amount chips (₹20/₹30/₹50) horizontally scrollable. Input field for custom amount or UPI ID, followed by a brandPrimary sticky 'Withdraw' button. Bottom section: Transaction & withdrawal history list with status badges (pending/successful/rejected).

screens.name: Play & Earn
screens.purpose: Mini-games and daily check-in to boost retention.
screens.layout: Top: Daily check-in hero card displaying a week progress bar with day bubbles. Below: 2-column game grid (flexWrap: wrap, space-between). Each game card (surfaceSecondary, radius: lg) has a cover image, bold title, and a 'Play' chip.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Top profile hero card with large avatar, name, and email. Vertical list of settings rows (Help, Terms, Privacy). Each row uses a brandTertiary tinted circular icon container on the left, title, and right chevron. Version number displayed as muted text at the bottom.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.layout: Grid of stat cards (Total Users, Pending Withdrawals, Active Offers). Below: Manage tabs for Users, Tasks, and Payouts. List view of pending payout requests with Quick Approve/Reject actions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the color token assignments: use brandPrimary (#0F172A) for primary bold titles and the main 'Continue' button to maintain the premium dark-navy contrast requested.
Ensure brandSecondary (#5B5BD6) is used specifically for the active segmented toggle and points/coins pill to match the indigo/purple accent instructions.
For the task cards and feature rows, apply the brandTertiary (#E8E8FA) background to circular icon containers to achieve the soft lavender effect requested.
Follow the explicit radius requirements: Cards should have ~20-24px rounded corners (use radius_tokens.xl or lg) to match the tactile/playful but structured vibe.
Do NOT use pure white backgrounds for the entire screen. Set the main screen background to surface (#F4F5F9) and use surfaceSecondary (#FFFFFF) purely for cards to create depth via shadow_tier 2.
In the Home screen, ensure the reward amounts are colored with the 'success' (#16A34A) token, and use the 'warning' (#FFC107) token for gold coin accents.
Implement the 'Continue' and 'Withdraw' buttons as sticky, full-width pill buttons anchored to the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView, avoiding overlap with scrollable content.
Ensure all components (including Segmented toggles and Banner Carousels) are built fully natively with React Native/Expo primitives and not web-like HTML/CSS.
Avoid using any banned colors (e.g., standard Material indigo, blue, red/orange) except for the EXACT explicitly requested #5B5BD6 indigo/purple accent token.
